item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-37c28150a42e7945","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"Bangladesh’s government cybersecurity authority published a national Cybersecurity Strategy covering 2021–2025, indicating a formal cybersecurity policy framework in force during 2023.","question_ids":["1B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The strategy period includes 2023, but the supplied extract does not show implementation, funding, enforcement, review, or outcomes during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies the Bangladesh government cybersecurity authority but does not attribute adoption or implementation directly to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["Only the title, publication date, and agency page metadata are supplied; the strategy’s substantive provisions are unavailable."]},{"source_id":"SRC-51459b0d9b7819f4","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Sheikh Hasina was listed as Bangladesh’s Prime Minister and speaker in the United Nations General Assembly general debate on 22 September 2023.","question_ids":["8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Directly attributed to Sheikh Hasina through the UN record identifying her as speaker and Bangladesh’s Prime Minister.","limitations":["The supplied record contains no speech text or details of the program, decisions, commitments, implementation, or outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-af5c8830319cdb1c","SRC-bdef500702c9166c","SRC-0a3f970b8a140491","SRC-adff4b6924f3d376","SRC-46f8b267ad24086d","SRC-976d31fadb331ab8","SRC-bb0f1193b69a31d4","SRC-66a46cbcae6fc6cc","SRC-86c350b5069ea9d2","SRC-e4432687572d851a"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern other countries, periods outside 2023, or contain only landing-page metadata without substantive findings.","No supplied document provides enough evidence to establish concrete 2023 facts across most 1B–8B questions."]}
